observations.body: The letter moves from death and hostile powers to mercy, shared life with Christ, salvation by grace through faith, and a life prepared for good works.
observations.label: Salvation by grace through faith leads to good works

payload.posture: Read Ephesians 2:1–10 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: Good works follow the gift in this sequence; they are not erased from the resulting life.
